## Context

The Cloud rate-limit sweep intentionally covers four transport-surface modules under `adapters/jira/`. Its `_step0_names()` input is hardcoded, so a classified mutating method can be renamed or moved into an unswept sibling module without the completeness assertion noticing. A package-wide glob was evaluated and rejected because it would redefine the sweep from the transport surface to the entire Jira package and require policy classification of 90 unrelated members.

Current measurement finds exactly two definitions outside the swept modules whose names are in `_CLASSIFIED_MUTATING`: `backend.py::set_relationship` and `backend.py::add_comment`. Both are pure, same-name `self.transport` delegations. The unswept package set also includes `acli_subprocess.py` and `jira_fields.py`; neither currently collides with the classified mutating names.

## Operator decision

Implement option B: retain the explicit transport file list and add a strict anti-drift guard over every other Python module in `adapters/jira/`. A classified mutating name is allowed outside the sweep only when its body is a pure same-name transport delegation with unchanged arguments. Reject package-wide globbing.

## Plan

- Make the four swept transport paths an explicit named constant used by `_step0_names()`.
- Parse every other Jira adapter Python module with `ast` and identify functions whose names collide with `_CLASSIFIED_MUTATING`.
- Accept only the deliberately narrow facade shape already used by `backend.py`: one return statement calling `self.transport.<same_name>` with the declared arguments forwarded unchanged. Any guard, retry, logging, argument transform, extra statement, or non-transport target fails.
- Add a test proving the current two backend facades are the only accepted collisions and a mutation-style fixture proving an unswept non-facade `add_comment` turns the guard red.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The existing transport sweep remains scoped to the same four modules; no package-wide glob widens the 429 policy surface.
- [x] An anti-drift assertion scans every other `adapters/jira/*.py` module, including `acli_subprocess.py` and `jira_fields.py`, for names in `_CLASSIFIED_MUTATING`.
- [x] The only allowed collision shape is a pure same-name `self.transport` delegation with arguments forwarded unchanged.
- [x] The current `backend.py::set_relationship` and `backend.py::add_comment` facades pass the guard.
- [x] A new or moved unswept definition using a classified mutating name fails unless it is that exact pure-facade shape.
- [x] The focused Cloud rate-limit sweep passes without changing production code.
